prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: Spain gallery documentary master. Create a wide 16:9 documentary night photograph of Dalt Vila, Eivissa/Ibiza at 01:14 local time on 24 September 2026. Real public Marina waterfront promenade viewpoint, eye-level looking southwest across a calm harbour toward the fortified old-town hill. Key anchors: massive angular Renaissance bastions climbing the hill; dense whitewashed lower old-town houses beneath and within the walls; the cathedral and compact bell-tower silhouette crowning the ridge. Partly clear deep navy-black sky with modest cloud, restrained warm historic architectural illumination as precedent rather than observed schedule, subdued harbour reflections. No crowds, readable business signs, cruise ship, giant yacht, fireworks, moon, stars, fantasy castle, duplicated cathedral, excessive orange glow, text, logos or watermark. Center the fortified hill and cathedral so a 4:5 crop remains complete.
